## Description

Register the principal entity, sender ID(s) and every SMS template (confirmation, reminders, cancellation, rebooking, waitlist offer, OTP) on a DLT platform; choose the SMS provider (Q-03). Record template IDs in configuration.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Entity, header (sender) and all P1 templates are approved with template IDs recorded.
- [ ] **AC2.** SMS provider contract/account exists and is connected in staging.
- [ ] **AC3.** A fallback (email only) is documented if approval slips.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
